---

*Please first create a user account on https://cms.openzim.org/ and follow process on https://wiki.openzim.org/wiki/Contribute_a_ZIM_file *

*Please use the following format for a community ZIM upload request*

- [ ] I have a CMS account
  - **Your CMS user account ID** (click on your name in the top-right box then "copy User ID")
- [ ] Original Website(s) URL
  - **https://xxx or equivalent**
- [ ] Content is legal in Switzerland
- [ ] Content does not advertise fringe theory
- [ ] Content is free content or open content or educational content with authorization for reproduction
   - License: **Creative Commons | Public domain | ...**
   - *Or send authorization to contact (at) kiwix (dot) org*
- Scraper or tool used: **informative, if standard openZIM scraper or tool**
- Suggested Title Name: **Must match our convention at https://wiki.openzim.org/wiki/Content_team/ZIM_Naming_Convention**

*For each ZIM, please run following checklist and include in request*

- [ ] ZIM Title is present and less than 30 characters
- [ ] ZIM Description is present and less than 80 characters
- [ ] ZIM Publisher is present and your name / org (do not use Kiwix or openZIM, you endorse the ZIM publishing responsibility)
- [ ] ZIM Creator is present and matches the org / person who created the original content
- [ ] ZIM Language contains only ISO639-3 codes, separated by commas, sorted by importance in the content (number of articles, ...) ; note that we encourage you to prefer one ZIM per language whenever reasonably feasible
- [ ] Running zimcheck on the ZIM does not raises significant errors(s)

*Kiwix/openZIM team will keep you posted once you can upload your ZIM*
